column1: # The files MDMesh kept from Headwind MDM (https://github.com/h-mdm/hmdm-server at upstream commit
# daed2099c9d50e68248ced38135180ffea6902ce), and the agent files ported from hmdm-android. Columns: path, the file's
# blob at that commit (or how it came), whether it carried the upstream copyright header there, and why
# it carries no in-file notice if it doesn't. A listed file that differs from that blob says MDMesh
# changed it. A file derived from an upstream one under another path has 'derived from <path>' in the
# blob column (a row added by hand) and says MDMesh changed it.
